assumptions: Known potential outcomes are used only by the scorer.
Policies observe imperfect drift alerts rather than hidden drift truth.
Risk values are engineering indices, not calibrated probabilities.
Named LLM baselines are deterministic decision-rule proxies.
metadata.claim_scope: Controlled-simulation engineering benchmark only. These results validate executable gates and failure behavior; they are not a causal research conclusion or real-world lift claim.
metadata.ground_truth: Known potential outcomes are simulation-only and use _gt fields. Detector observations are imperfect and distinct from hidden drift truth.
metadata.llm_baseline_disclosure: direct_proxy, react_like_proxy, verbal_confidence, and causalpilot_no_trace are deterministic decision-rule proxies; they are not executions of a named language model.
metadata.truth_policy_separation: Policies receive PolicyObservation only. EpisodeTruth is supplied solely to score_policy. TRACE calls causalpilot.policy.evaluate_trace_policy and select_minimum_scope, the same shared policy functions used by the backend engine.
